meta.title: Optimize power meter debug logging to fix HTTP timeout issues
meta.body_summary: Wrap debug logging in power meter providers (HTTP JSON, SDM Serial, SML) behind a DTU_LOG_IS_DEBUG guard to reduce runtime overhead and fix reported HTTP timeout errors.

core_change_summary.description: In three power meter provider files (http/Provider.cpp, sdm/serial/Provider.cpp, sml/Provider.cpp), wrapped the debug logging call to getPowerTotal() inside an `if (DTU_LOG_IS_DEBUG)` guard to prevent function call and string formatting overhead when debug is disabled.
change_trajectory: Add debug guard to HTTP JSON provider.
Apply same guard to SDM and SML providers.
